identity.verdict: SESSION-LOCAL — 25 person ids appear under more than one session/location, so P### is an index within a recording, not a global subject id. Split on identity_key, never on person.

splits.verdict: LEAKY — the shipped split has zero clip overlap but shares subjects: test&train 132 (93.6% of identities appear on both sides). A model can memorise a face in training and be scored on it at test. Numbers from this split are not comparable to a subject-disjoint benchmark — build our own.

leakage.verdict: A random clip-level split contaminates 100.0% of the test set with subjects seen in training. Split on identity, not on clips.
